title: Parallel mean curvature surfaces with constant contact angle along free boundaries
summary: We classify branched immersed disks in space forms with non-zero parallel mean curvature vector and non-orthogonal constant contact angle along the boundary in 4-dimensional space form. For higher codimensional case, we prove a codimension reduction theorem for branched immersed bordered Riemann surfaces of higher genus with multiple boundary components under the same parallel mean curvature and constant contact angle assumptions.
